Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth of July
[image: Fireworks]
Celebrate Safely: Union City Fireworks Guidelines for the Fourth of July

*UNION CITY, CA, July 2, 2026 - *As our nation’s 250th Anniversary
approaches, Union City reminds residents to celebrate responsibly and make
safety a top priority. Only *State Fire Marshal-approved “safe and sane”*
fireworks are permitted in Union City, and their use must comply with local
and state laws.

*Key Safety Guidelines:*

   - Use fireworks only on private property with the *owner’s permission*,
   July 1-4, from *8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.*
   - Keep fireworks *at least 10 feet from any structure.*
   - Always have adult supervision and a hose or water source nearby.
   - Soak used fireworks overnight in water, double-bag them, and place
   them in your landfill bin -* never in your recycling or compost cart.*
   - *Fireworks are prohibited east of Mission Boulevard*, in *City parks*,
   on *school grounds*, and on *public streets.*

Union City also discourages residents from using illegal fireworks, which
include firecrackers, bottle rockets, aerial shells, and mortars. Pursuant
to UCMC 7.26
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fecode360.com%2F43309453%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=%2343309462/1/0100019f24d9650b-a18bd947-dc82-4db5-9789-d2f2ab16aa2b-000000/yoRMkbQUjjifzGL-5MyiJIrNpShoaRuNVEAybBC_83M=452>,
individuals possessing or using illegal fireworks (i.e. any firework other
than State of CA Fire Marshal-approved “safe and sane” fireworks) may be
fined up to $1,000.

Pursuant to Union City’s “Social Host Ordinance,” property owners can also
be fined up to $1,000 if illegal fireworks are used at their property.
Officers can administer these citations in-person or by sending them to the
property owner by mail.

To report illegal fireworks, call Union City Police Dispatch at *510*.*471.1365
(Option 3)*. For full regulations and safety tips, visit
www.unioncityca.gov/fireworks
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.unioncityca.gov%2F395%2FFireworks-Laws-and-Safety%3Futm_content=%26utm_medium=email%26utm_name=%26utm_source=govdelivery%26utm_term=/1/0100019f24d9650b-a18bd947-dc82-4db5-9789-d2f2ab16aa2b-000000/7-_sWoCu7OA6VaRkNPo-txAlQH5VLTWs8ktkD5zi_3k=452>
.

On our nation’s 250th birthday, let’s celebrate together - safely,
responsibly, and with pride in our community. Have a happy and safe Fourth
of July, Union City!
